construction.long_call: exactly 2.00 points above selected short call
construction.long_put: exactly 2.00 points below selected short put
construction.short_call: listed 0DTE strike nearest the data-derived call wall; lower strike wins ties
construction.short_put: listed 0DTE strike nearest the data-derived put wall; higher strike wins ties

control.classification: HIGH_PIN_PRESSURE at fixed entry is treatment; every other priceable grade is non-HIGH control
control.matching: same symbol, 0DTE expiry, fixed clock window, construction, quote rules, costs, and settlement
control.primary_comparison: mean net P&L on HIGH days minus mean net P&L on non-HIGH days

entry.rule: first scanner observation in the eligible fixed-clock window

management.terminal_rule: hold all four legs to 0DTE expiry

missingness.required: candidate walls, four exact listed contracts, clean fresh quotes, positive net credit after slippage, and Alpaca SIP close

pricing.entry_credit: short call mid + short put mid - long call mid - long put mid
pricing.option_source: FlashAlpha live /v1/optionquote/SPY filtered to same-session expiry

report.matched_null: one-sided contiguous five-session-block sign-flip test of HIGH-day P&L minus the non-HIGH mean, with finite-sample plus-one correction
report.primary_metric: HIGH mean net P&L minus non-HIGH mean net P&L

settlement.call_intrinsic_points: max(SPY close - short call, 0) - max(SPY close - long call, 0)
settlement.commission_application: subtract four entry-leg commissions once; no modeled exit commission
settlement.net_pnl_dollars: (slippage-adjusted credit points - put intrinsic points - call intrinsic points) * 100 - commissions
settlement.put_intrinsic_points: max(short put - SPY close, 0) - max(long put - SPY close, 0)
